description: Source code for the DStreamGraph class in Apache Spark Streaming, managing streaming data flow graphs including input/output streams, job generation, checkpointing, and synchronization.

classes.name: DStreamGraph
classes.description: Manages the streaming data flow graph, including input/output streams, job scheduling, checkpointing, and synchronization.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the streaming graph at a given start time.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Restarts the streaming graph at a specified time.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all input streams in the graph.

methods.name: setContext
methods.description: Sets the StreamingContext for all output streams.

methods.name: setBatchDuration
methods.description: Sets the batch duration for streaming.

methods.name: remember
methods.description: Sets the remember duration for input streams.

methods.name: addInputStream
methods.description: Adds an input stream to the graph.

methods.name: addOutputStream
methods.description: Adds an output stream to the graph.

methods.name: getInputStreams
methods.description: Returns all input streams.

methods.name: getOutputStreams
methods.description: Returns all output streams.

methods.name: getReceiverInputStreams
methods.description: Returns all receiver input streams.

methods.name: getNumReceivers
methods.description: Returns the number of receiver input streams.

methods.name: getInputStreamNameAndID
methods.description: Returns the sequence of input stream names and IDs.

methods.name: generateJobs
methods.description: Generates jobs for a given time based on output streams.

methods.name: clearMetadata
methods.description: Clears metadata for a specific time.

methods.name: updateCheckpointData
methods.description: Updates checkpoint data for a specific time.

methods.name: clearCheckpointData
methods.description: Clears checkpoint data for a specific time.

methods.name: restoreCheckpointData
methods.description: Restores checkpoint data.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the streaming graph configuration.

methods.name: getMaxInputStreamRememberDuration
methods.description: Returns the maximum remember duration across input streams.

methods.name: writeObject
methods.description: Serializes the object for checkpointing.

methods.name: readObject
methods.description: Deserializes the object from checkpoint data.
